description: This PHP source file defines the HandlerStack class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which manages middleware stacks for HTTP request handling. It provides methods to create, configure, and resolve middleware chains used by Guzzle HTTP clients.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses. Provides methods to construct, modify, and resolve middleware chains.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default handler stack with middleware for errors, redirects, cookies, and body preparation, optionally wrapping a provided handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a HandlerStack with an optional underlying HTTP handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the handler stack as a composed callable with a given request and options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the underlying HTTP handler that returns a promise.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks whether a handler has been set.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds a middleware to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a middleware to the top of the stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts a middleware before another middleware identified by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts a middleware after another middleware identified by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a middleware from the stack by instance or name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Builds and returns the final composed handler callable, resolving the middleware stack.
